paragraphs.en: Almost all animals have distinct vocals (（声音）) that they rely on to either ask for help, {scare} away any dangerous animals or look for {shelter} .When a dog barks loudly, it {announces} that something is wrong or that it needs help. {Elephants} would use calls in a low {frequency} to keep the group together, especially when they are in {danger} .A male bird may {sing} to attract a mate, trying to {convince} a {female} that it is {suitable} as a {partner} .
paragraphs.cn: 几乎所有动物都有独特的叫声，它们依靠这些叫声来寻求帮助， <u> 吓 </u> 跑任何危险的动物或寻求 <u> 躲避处 </u> 。当一只狗大声吠叫时，它是在 <u> 表示 </u> 有情况不对劲，或者它需要帮助。 <u> 大象 </u> 会用低 <u> 频 </u> 的叫声让象群保持在一起，尤其是在遇到 <u> 危险 </u> 的时候。雄鸟会 <u> 唱歌 </u> 来吸引配偶，试图 <u> 让雌鸟相信 </u> 它是 <u> 合适的伴侣 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: But {cats} are creatures who possess special vocalization (（发声）) skills.They are able to have entire conversations with humans using {meows} and you're able to {interpret} them.If a {pet} cat is hungry, it will sit near its food {bowl} and keep meowing to attract attention.When a cat feels {threatened} , it might let out an aggressive {hiss} that serves as a {warning} .Purring is a way for the cat to show that it feels {secure} .However, when a cat is looking for {affection} , it tends to produce {stretched} and soft meows.Meowing starts as soon as a baby cat is brought to life and is used to get the mother's attention and be {fed} .
paragraphs.cn: 然而， <u> 猫 </u> 是拥有特殊发声技巧的动物。它们能够通过 <u> 喵喵的叫声 </u> 与人类进行完整的交流，而人们也能 <u> 解读 </u> 这些叫声。如果一只 <u> 宠物 </u> 猫饿了，它就会坐在自己的食 <u> 碗 </u> 附近不停地喵喵叫以引起注意。当一只猫感受到 <u> 威胁 </u> 时，它可能会发出具有攻击性的 <u> 嘶嘶声 </u> 以示 <u> 警告 </u> 。发出呼噜声是猫表达 <u> 安全 </u> 感的一种方式。然而，当一只猫想要得到 <u> 爱抚 </u> 时，它往往会发出 <u> 拉长 </u> 且轻柔的喵喵声。猫宝宝一出生就开始喵喵叫，并用它来引起猫妈妈的注意，好让自己得到 <u> 喂食 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: Cats have many {heightened} senses, but their sense of smell is quite {impressive} .This ability helps them {hunt} in the wild.They will sniff out specific {areas} before they choose a place as their {territory} .However, another way the cats are able to distinguish between situations is by looking for {familiar} smells.Your cat will likely smell your face or {clothes} and {store} the smell in its memory and use it to recognize you in the future.Therefore, they rub their face against your legs to {attach} their scent to you.Their scent acts like a form of {advertisement} , telling other animals that they are familiar with you.
paragraphs.cn: 猫有许多 <u> 敏锐的 </u> 感官，而它们的嗅觉尤其 <u> 令人印象深刻 </u> 。这种能力帮助它们在野外 <u> 捕猎 </u> 。在选择某个地方作为自己的 <u> 领地 </u> 前，它们会把特定的 <u> 区域 </u> 嗅闻一遍。然而，猫能够分辨不同情况的另一种方式是寻找 <u> 熟悉的 </u> 气味。你的猫很可能会闻你的脸或 <u> 衣服 </u> ，并将这些气味 <u> 储存 </u> 在它的记忆中，日后凭借这些气味来认出你。因此，它们会用脸蹭你的腿，好让自己的气味 <u> 附着 </u> 在你身上。它们的气味就像一种 <u> 广告 </u> 形式，向其他动物表明它们和你很熟。

paragraphs.en: Dogs are known for their impressive {fetching} habit, but cats take this behavior up a {notch} .Many cats will find random objects outside and leave them {alongside} their owners as gifts.This is a very old habit that's been present in all kinds of predators (（食肉动物）) .Cats bring gifts for their owners to show they love them or to display their {authority} over the home.These {adorable} little {hunters} are just doing something that has been in their nature since the beginning of time. {Altogether} , cats have unique ways to show their feelings.Just go along with it!
paragraphs.cn: 狗以出色的“ <u> 叼取 </u> ”习性而闻名，但猫在这方面的行为还要更上一个 <u> 档次 </u> 。许多猫会在外面找到一些随意的物件，然后把它们放到主人 <u> 身边 </u> 当作 <u> 礼物 </u> 。这是一种非常古老的习性，常见于各种肉食动物。猫给主人带礼物是为了表达它们对主人的喜爱，或者彰显自己在家中的“ <u> 权威 </u> ”。这些 <u> 可爱的 </u> 小 <u> 猎手 </u> 只是在做一些从一开始就存在于它们天性中的事情。 <u> 总之 </u> ，猫拥有独特的情感表达方式。那就顺其自然吧！ 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
